ja.title: 同じ遺伝子を抑えるsiRNAでも同じ薬にはならない
ja.summary: 80本のsiRNAを測ったOTSポスターを読み、標的抑制と転写応答で候補をどう選ぶかを考える。図の10点からの判断例と読み取り幅への感度分析、qPCRとの費用比較を添える。

en.title: siRNA selection: target knockdown and transcriptional changes
en.summary: Approximate poster coordinates illustrate siRNA candidate tradeoffs, reading uncertainty and why changed-gene counts do not directly measure off-target effects.
en.seo_title: siRNA selection: knockdown and transcriptional changes
en.seo_description: Approximate poster coordinates illustrate siRNA candidate tradeoffs, reading uncertainty and why changed-gene counts do not directly measure off-target effects.

english.title: Choosing between siRNAs that silence the same target
english.summary: A Japanese technical essay audits an OTS poster on 80 siRNAs, distinguishes transcriptional effects from off-target liability, and explores conditional candidate selection using approximate coordinates from ten plotted points.
